The complete Elden Ring package lands on Switch 2. Visually speaking we're getting a match for the last-gen PS4 release in core settings - though as a plus, Switch 2's frame-rate exceeds that older Sony release, while its resolution locks at the target 1080p more consistently. Comparisons against Series S are less flattering meanwhile. The lack of DLSS is also perhaps a missed opportunity, but on the whole Nintendo's handheld puts in a robust rendition of a true From Software classic.
